:::{#def-critical-point}
#### Critical point

A **critical point** of a differentiable function $f$
is an input value $x_0$ where the derivative of $f$ is zero,
or, for a function of a vector,
a point $\vx_0$ where the gradient $f'$ of $f$ is the zero vector:

$$
\begin{aligned}
f'(x_0) &= 0 && \text{(scalar input)}\\
f'(\vx_0) &= \vzero && \text{(vector input)}
\end{aligned}
$$
:::
